company_name: BeiJing E-Town Semiconductor Technology Co., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — BeiJing E-Town Semiconductor Technology Co., LTD specializes in semiconductor equipment, particularly in dry strip, dry etch, and RTP solutions.
summary: BeiJing E-Town Semiconductor Technology Co., LTD (BEST) is a semiconductor equipment manufacturer that provides advanced solutions for dry strip, dry etch, and rapid thermal processing (RTP) for 300 mm wafer customers globally. The company has a strong customer service system and has established a manufacturing facility in Beijing to support its operations.

regional_presence.China: The company has a manufacturing facility in Beijing that began production in September 2018.
